Services

One team for the whole journey: counselling, test training, admissions, scholarships, loans, visa, forex, flights and support after you land.

What we do for you

  • Zero upfront fee, free counselling

    Talk to our experts for free. You pay nothing to get started.

  • IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, Duolingo and GRE training

    Coaching for the test your universities ask for, from the same team handling your application.

  • Admission into top-ranked universities

    Applications to leading universities in India and abroad.

  • Scholarships available

    We look for the scholarships and fee waivers you qualify for and help you apply.

  • Low initial deposit

    Start your admission with a small deposit rather than a large one-time payment.

  • Financial services and bank loan assistance

    End-to-end help with your education loan, from choosing a lender to getting the sanction letter.

  • Visa processing and slot booking

    Visa file preparation, interview practice and help booking your appointment slot.

  • Forex and flight ticketing

    Foreign exchange and student-friendly flight tickets, arranged through us.

  • Pre-departure and accommodation assistance

    A briefing before you fly and help finding somewhere to live when you land.

  • University transfers in the USA

    Already in the US and want to change university? We handle the transfer process.

  • Academic assignment guidance

    Support with assignments and academic writing once your course begins.

The full journey, end to end

Ten stages, in this order. Most students take 8 to 12 months from the first to the last.

  1. 01

    Free 1:1 counselling

    We look at your marks, budget and goals, and tell you plainly which countries and courses are realistic.

  2. 02

    Test preparation

    IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, Duolingo or GRE training, depending on what your universities need.

  3. 03

    University shortlist

    A list of universities that fit your profile, with fees, deadlines and the reason for each choice.

  4. 04

    Applications and SOP

    We prepare your documents and statement of purpose, submit your applications and track every one.

  5. 05

    Offer and scholarships

    We help you compare offers, apply for scholarships and accept the right one.

  6. 06

    Education loan

    From eligibility to sanction letter. The loan process is explained step by step below.

  7. 07

    Visa and slot booking

    We prepare your visa file, practise the interview with you and help book your appointment.

  8. 08

    Forex and flights

    Foreign exchange, your fee payment and a flight ticket, arranged through us.

  9. 09

    Accommodation and pre-departure

    Help finding a place to live, plus a briefing on what to pack and what to expect.

  10. 10

    Support after you land

    Our UK office, university transfers in the USA, and academic assignment guidance during your course.

Financial services

How the education loan works

We stay with you through each step, from checking eligibility to the day the bank pays your university.

Ask about a loan
  1. 01

    Check your eligibility

    We look at your admission, course, co-applicant income and any collateral, and tell you which loan types fit.

  2. 02

    Compare lenders

    Public-sector banks, private banks and NBFCs differ on interest rate, collateral, margin and processing time. We lay the options side by side.

  3. 03

    Gather documents

    Admission letter, fee structure, academic records, KYC for you and your co-applicant, income proof, and property papers if the loan is secured.

  4. 04

    Apply and follow up

    We help you fill the application and stay in touch with the bank until it is processed.

  5. 05

    Sanction letter

    Once approved, the bank issues a sanction letter, which you can use as proof of funds for many visa applications.

  6. 06

    Disbursement

    The bank pays the tuition fee directly to your university, usually term by term, and releases living costs as agreed.

What to bring to your first meeting

You do not need everything ready. The more we can see, the more specific our advice will be.

  • Class 10, Class 12 and degree mark sheets (photos on your phone are fine)
  • Your passport, if you have one
  • Any English test or GRE score you already have
  • A rough idea of your budget, and whether you plan to take a loan
  • Countries or courses you are curious about, even if you are not sure yet
